abstract: BACKGROUND/PURPOSE: Data on the clinical features of children with central diabetes insipidus (CDI) are lacking in Taiwan. This study investigated the clinical manifestations and etiology of CDI in Taiwanese children. METHODS: From 1983 to 2012, 62 children with permanent diabetes insipidus were enrolled in the study. They were diagnosed at the Department of Pediatrics of National Taiwan University Hospital. Their medical records were thoroughly reviewed and their clinical symptoms and signs, laboratory data, and etiologies were analyzed. RESULTS: The patients' median age at diagnosis was 10 years and the median interval between initial manifestations and diagnosis was 0.5 years. The most common symptoms and signs were polyuria, polydipsia, nocturia, and growth retardation. Most patients had low urine osmolality and elevated plasma osmolality on diagnosis. Absence of a posterior pituitary hyperintense signal and thickening of the pituitary stalk were common findings on magnetic resonance imaging. Approximately 80% of the patients had anterior pituitary hormone deficiency and all patients had growth hormone deficiency. Approximately 60% of patients had intracranial lesions, the most common causes of which were germ cell tumor and Langerhans cell histiocytosis. Two patients were initially believed to have idiopathic CDI but intracranial lesions were detected during the follow-up period. CONCLUSION: Because a delayed diagnosis of CDI is common in Taiwanese children, a high index of suspicion is important. The underlying etiology of CDI in children may not initially be obvious. Long-term surveillance is therefore necessary, especially for the early detection of evolving treatable intracranial lesions.
abstract_ja: 背景・目的：台湾の小児における中枢性尿崩症(CDI)の臨床像は十分に明らかになっていない。本研究では、台湾の小児CDIの臨床症状と病因を検討した。方法：1983年から2012年の間に永続性尿崩症と診断された62例の小児を登録した。診断は国立台湾大学病院の小児科で行われた。診療録を詳細に検討し、臨床症状・徴候、検査所見、病因を分析した。結果：診断時の年齢中央値は10歳、初発症状から診断までの期間の中央値は0.5年であった。最も多い症状・徴候は多尿、多飲、夜間頻尿、成長障害であった。多くの患者で診断時に尿浸透圧は低く、血漿浸透圧は上昇していた。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では、神経下垂体の高信号の消失と下垂体茎の肥厚がよく認められた。約80%の患者で下垂体前葉ホルモン欠損があり、全例で成長ホルモン欠損があった。約60%の患者に頭蓋内病変があり、最も多い原因は胚細胞腫瘍とランゲルハンス細胞組織球症であった。特発性CDIと考えられていた2例は、経過中に頭蓋内病変が発見された。結論：台湾の小児ではCDIの診断が遅れることが多いため、高い疑い指数が重要である。小児CDIの原因は当初明らかでないことがある。したがって、治療可能な頭蓋内病変の早期発見のため、長期的な経過観察が必要である。
